purpose: Controlled audio adaptation, encoder and training-memory comparison
feature: Hann-windowed, DC-removed, one-sided FFT band mean-square energy in dBFS; six independent bands
normalizer: Fit per-band median and max(3dB,1.4826*MAD) on first150 frames only; z=.5+.5*(band-center)/(scale+abs(band-center)); then freeze
bootstrap: One pass over normalized fit frames for SNN and continuous banks, same band seeds seed+band; no calibration/probe training of source models
neural: Six independent SensingPredictor instances (12 units each), existing fixed tau/input/readout/eligibility/learning constants; SNN and continuous control differ only by spiking dynamics
fixed_reference: Freeze a copy of the fully fitted adaptive SNN parameters. Parameters and normalization stay fixed; transient state evolves on the same live frames
calibration: Independent trained copies process next150 frames with matching learning flags; discard their updates. Threshold=max(1e-9,maximum sqrt(mean6(previous_forecast-target)^2) after25-frame warmup). Strict > produces zero calibration alarms by construction, without guaranteeing future rate
probe: Same held-out100-frame tape evaluated without learning on reset copies at monitor0 and every300 monitor frames, warmup25. Never store these frames in either training memory; no selection or tuning from probe outcomes
monitor: Predict before receiving target; score and emit threshold alarm before updating. Score is sqrt(mean six squared errors); warmup25frames, at least25 frame indices between alarms. Same live frames for all five arms; states continue through monitor; no event/fault labels
baselines: Persistence predicts the current six features as the next features. EMA initializes from the first frame and uses alpha=1-exp(-.2/5)=0.03921056084767682 per nominal0.2s frame. Reset baseline state at calibration/probe/monitor boundaries
alarm_rate_denominator: Scored feature frames times0.2 seconds; exclude initial25 warmup frames. First complete block has275 scored frames=55s; later complete blocks300=60s
clock: Model time is sample-derived (global_frame+1)*.2 seconds at nominal16kHz, distinct from monotonic delivery timestamps. Raw PCM does not carry measured hardware timestamps
comparison: Each300-frame nonoverlapping monitoring block reports paired next-frame MSE against fixed SNN, ANN, EMA and persistence, plus cumulative MSE and observed alarms/minute. First block omits25 warmup targets. Relative improvement=(fixed_mse-adaptive_mse)/fixed_mse, null if fixed_mse=0
report: Prediction error and observed alarm rate, not detection accuracy, faults, confirmed false positives, independent trials or chip energy. No claims from changes in surprise alone
signal_check: A short pre-model capture may confirm signal/frequencies before this protocol. Capture source must be a physical input, never an output monitor; no default/gain changes
privacy: Raw audio is discarded after feature extraction. Exact feature/forecast traces and learned arrays stay in a private local state directory, outside Git. Publish aggregate measurements only
stopping: Prospective comparison stops after9000 monitor frames; preserve old run and all private snapshots. Retrospective and prospective claims remain separate.

memory.fit_memory: Only normalized fit frames0..149; immutable and never populated with calibration, sealed probe or monitor data
memory.recent_memory_control: Most recent150 causal monitoring observations, excluding all calibration and probe observations; same replay cadence/length as fit memory
memory.activation: After each300 scored online training targets (including warmup learning), first replay at monitor frame301. Replay150 observations/149 targets on a transient training copy, then copy learned parameters only back before the next live forecast. Preserve live temporal state and pending-credit causality; no replay inside replay or evaluation
memory.matched_initialization: All SNN arms receive identical full-learning fit pass and match parameter hashes at monitor0; readout-only disables encoder learning after fit. ANN memory/control receive matching ANN fit pass
memory.work: Report all forward/update/synapse counts including replay, passes/targets and wall time. Retain recent-memory SNN and fit-memory ANN to distinguish extra optimization and architecture from old-example retention
memory.capacity: 150 six-band normalized training frames per bank; report logical samples/parameters and work, not chip memory or energy

comparison_stages.retrospective: Exactly original first30 monitor minutes from preserved private feature trace; three fixed seeds. Original evaluation probe remains evaluation-only. Previously examined outcomes make this diagnostic, not new held-out validation
comparison_stages.prospective: Separately named future microphone session with same frozen fit/calibration/probe scheme and30 monitoring minutes. Seed0 online, then replay identical captured feature tape for seeds0,1,2 serially after bounded capture stops; require online/replay seed0 agreement. No recipe tuning from either probe
comparison_stages.publication: Retain all arms/seeds and negative outcomes; publish source-specific artifacts. No tags or CI waiting

inversion_diagnostic.scope: Retrospective original first30 monitoring minutes only; score previous saved predictions against actual normalized targets
transforms: both prediction and target complemented (MSE invariance check)
inversion_diagnostic.limitations: Changing chart sign changes interpretation only. Prediction complement is a different causal predictor; any benefit on previously examined data requires new held-out confirmation. No model updates or probe training in this diagnostic
